rows.name: declaration-unused-concise
rows.hypothesis: Unused concise templates validate grammar, but their identifiers are not resolved or executed.

rows.name: declaration-unused-braced
rows.hypothesis: Unused braced comma-separated definitions validate and retain actual source owners.

rows.name: declaration-forward-alias
rows.hypothesis: An unused forward alias resolves its real scoped macro item without creating textual scope.

rows.name: declaration-restricted-scope
rows.hypothesis: Restricted scoped visibility follows its actual declaration module, including unused import aliases.

rows.name: declaration-module-identities
rows.hypothesis: Same-spelled macros in distinct actual modules have distinct item bindings.

rows.name: declaration-shadow-builtin-unused
rows.hypothesis: A scoped name can shadow a builtin item without granting builtin execution.

rows.name: declaration-cfg-disabled-no-gate
rows.hypothesis: A disabled declaration neither requires decl_macro nor compiles its inactive matcher/template.

rows.name: declaration-unused-transparent
rows.hypothesis: Actual configured-owner transparency transparent is retained as declaration data, not execution authority.

rows.name: declaration-unused-semiopaque
rows.hypothesis: Actual configured-owner transparency semiopaque is retained as declaration data, not execution authority.

rows.name: declaration-unused-opaque
rows.hypothesis: Actual configured-owner transparency opaque is retained as declaration data, not execution authority.

rows.name: declaration-captured-generated-names
rows.hypothesis: Legacy expansion can publish distinct captured scoped declaration names, without textual insertion of those scoped items.

rows.name: declaration-original-assert-matches
rows.hypothesis: The exact original assert_matches declaration is validated/retained without invocation; local stability remains a separately diagnosed candidate frontier.

rows.name: declaration-missing-gate
rows.hypothesis: Enabled scoped declarations require the actual root decl_macro request even when unused.

rows.name: declaration-wrong-separator
rows.hypothesis: Scoped rules require commas; legacy semicolons do not become an accepted scoped grammar.

rows.name: declaration-unbound-variable
rows.hypothesis: Unused scoped definitions still reject an unbound template metavariable.

rows.name: declaration-duplicate
rows.hypothesis: Duplicate same-context macro items reject before replacing an existing binding.

rows.name: declaration-private-import
rows.hypothesis: A sibling cannot import a private scoped declaration, even without invocation.

rows.name: declaration-nonancestor-restriction
rows.hypothesis: A restricted visibility path must name an actual ancestor module.

rows.name: declaration-unknown-transparency
rows.hypothesis: An unknown transparency string is not silently ignored.

rows.name: declaration-duplicate-transparency
rows.hypothesis: Pinned parser rejects repeated transparency attributes instead of choosing one.

rows.name: declaration-transparency-missing-gate
rows.hypothesis: The declaration gate does not supply rustc_attrs authorization for its internal attribute.

rows.name: declaration-transparency-wrong-target
rows.hypothesis: A function owner cannot lend an internal transparency contract to a macro declaration.

rows.name: declaration-invoke-direct
rows.hypothesis: Direct selection remains explicitly unsupported before scoped matching/capture/mark/invocation work.

rows.name: declaration-invoke-qualified
rows.hypothesis: Qualified lookup selects the real item and then rejects unsupported execution.

rows.name: declaration-invoke-alias
rows.hypothesis: An import alias cannot hide the scoped execution boundary.

rows.name: declaration-invoke-forward
rows.hypothesis: A forward call cannot fall back or execute an incomplete declaration.

rows.name: declaration-invoke-shadow-builtin
rows.hypothesis: Selecting a scoped shadow of a builtin rejects rather than executing the builtin.

rows.name: declaration-invoke-nested-legacy
rows.hypothesis: A reached scoped child rejects; valid enclosing legacy work does not grant scoped capture/mark/invocation work.

rows.name: declaration-invoke-eager
rows.hypothesis: A reached scoped eager argument rejects before its own matching/capture/mark/invocation work; the enclosing builtin has separate work.

rows.name: declaration-claimed-cfg-select
rows.hypothesis: The next original-core scoped builtin declaration does not become an empty executable or fabricated role.

rows.name: declaration-unknown-builtin-claim
rows.hypothesis: An unknown builtin claim is retained as a separate Rust rejection hypothesis, not accepted inert role data.
